instagram.title: Got Instagram?
instagram.description: Does your team (or prominent team member have an instagram username or hashtag? Include @ or #, respectively.

racer-type.title: What type of team are you?
racer-type.description: Most teams should choose racer. See the construction rules for guidance. We love art carts and you should to, and if you are going to be an art cart you have to present something super rad and have it approved.

buddies.title: Did you want to race alongside any other teams or people? Who?
buddies.description: If you are officially collaborating with other teams this year, or if you just want to race in the same route as your buddies, specify the team names here. If you don't know the team names, go ask them, and/or specify the first and last name of a team member

theme-chosen.title: Do you have a theme chosen for your cart yet?
theme-chosen.description: All carts need a theme! CHIditarod is about theatrical chaos and immersive experiences. Don't be afraid to get creative

racing-for-time.title: Are you primarily racing for time?
racing-for-time.description: We want to know if your team is primarily racing to win the fastest cart so we can ensure that you are placed optimally

explain-theme.title: Your theme, what's it all about?
explain-theme.description: What theme are you planning, and what sorts of ideas do you have for creating it? You must provide us with at least some information. If you don't know yet, put TBD

primary-inspiration.title: What most closely matches your primary inspiration for racing in CHIditarod?
primary-inspiration.description: We want to know what really gets you revved up to race shopping carts in the freezing cold.
enum: Doing a good thing but doing it all wrong

secondary-inspiration.title: What is your secondary inspiration?
enum: Doing a good thing but doing it all wrong

agree-to-core-philosophy.title: Did you read and will you follow the Core Philosophy?
agree-to-core-philosophy.description: CHIditarod takes this very seriously, and feels you should, too. Do you understand that violations will result in you not being allowed to participate?

agree-to-rules.title: Did you read and will you follow the race rules?
agree-to-rules.description: Ahem, this also means, do you understand you can be DQ'd if you do not pay attention to all the rules? They change every year. Reading the F.A.Q. will make you a better racer, and more attractive.

agree-to-sabotage.title: Have you read and agreed to the sabotage rules?
agree-to-sabotage.description: To review: The sabotage rules are indeed rules. Don't spoil anyone's day by being a jerk and getting DQ'd.

agree-to-cart-deposit.title: Have you read and agreed to the cart rules?
agree-to-cart-deposit.description: Make sure you read the rules. They are updated every year.

agree-to-cart-food-poundage.title: Do you agree to bring at least the the minimum amount of food, toiletries, or cash donation for our food drive?
agree-to-cart-food-poundage.description:
Returning in 2026! You choose to bring your food drive donation in multiple ways:
  • 69+ pounds of food
  • 69+ pounds of toiletries
  • A combination of 69+ pounds of food and toiletries
  • A $125 donation to our food drive partner, Nourishing Hope. (More details to come).
    • You must bring your donation to the starting line check-in. If you plan on raising GOBS of food, contact us for special pre-drop arrangements to make your life easier.

agree-not-a-donation.title: Do you understand the nature of your registration fee?
agree-not-a-donation.description: The money you're paying is a fee to participate in the CHIditarod, not a donation to the CHIditarod Foundation.

agree-to-orientation.title: Do you agree to attend the pre-race orientation?
agree-to-orientation.description: As in years past, this year there is a mandatory racer meeting, taking place on Wednesday, February 25 from 7-9 pm CT, located at Midwest Coast Brewing. This is the only instance of the racer meeting and at least 1 person from each team must attend. Thus, if your ensemble has 3 registered teams, you must send a minimum of 3 people to orientation, or YOU CANNOT RACE. You are welcome to bring more than 1 person but we need at least 1. If your team is coming from more than 100 miles away, please email liz@chiditarod.org to make other arrangements.

flame-effects.title: Fire Effects
flame-effects.description:
Do you want to have ANY fire on your cart? Examples:
  • Grills
  • Propane-based flame effects
  • Tiki torches (not allowed)
If so, describe in detail in the private comments. Must be approved. You also agree to bring an up-to-date fire extinguisher.

fundraising.title: Do you plan on Fundraising?! Say yes!
fundraising.description: We want to help however we can to make fundraising for the race easy, fun, and rewarding.  Did you know that many companies offer matching grant programs? It's as easy as contacting your HR department.
enum: Yes, and I will ask my company about their matching grant programs

cart-parking.title: Overnight Cart Parking
cart-parking.description:
We will again offer the ability to park your cart at the finish line (with caveats). Which of these do you anticipate doing with your cart once you arrive at the finish line?
  • Long Term - Park at finish line overnight, pickup next day between 12 pm - 2 pm SHARP
  • Short Term - Park at finish line during awards ceremony; pick up that night afterwards
  • Super Short Term - Take cart away from finish line immediately

referred-by.title: How did you hear about CHIditarod?
referred-by.description: Was it a friend, specific website, specific social media channel, another organization, etc.

collaborating.title: Are you collaborating with any other teams this year?
collaborating.description: If you have an ensemble of more than 1 cart, or you want to try and race alongside your friends, rivals, or frivals, please indicate Yes and share the other team names in the private comments. If you have questions email registration@chiditarod.org.

raced-in-past.title: Have any of your team members raced CHIditarod in the past?
raced-in-past.description: If ANY of your team members have raced CHIditarod ever, select 'Yes'

form.title: Let's get to know each other

items.helpvalue:
The primary mission of the CHIditarod is to harness the love and energy of Chicagoans to forge positive connections and social good across our communities. The annual CHIditarod race aims to accomplish this goal by fostering a culture of mutual care and creative community engagement.

Flagrant violation of these core philosophies will result in exclusion from the event. Examples of such violations include, but are not limited to, disrespecting others or the property of others, performing racial or cultural stereotypes, participating in or promoting hate speech, enacting sabotage that borders on assault, and wasting food for sabotage or other ill-conceived purposes. Such behaviors bring harm to members of our community and are therefore harmful to all of us.

items.inlinetitle: I understand that my registration fees are not a donation to the foundation.

items.helpvalue: The CHIditarod's impact goes far beyond a single's day of fun. Thanks to YOU -- our paricipants -- CHIditarod raises thousands of dollars each year for our Microgrant Program, funding the hunger-fighting missions of Chicago-area nonprofits.
